Count Wrongula - Album 1: WHO

No Invitation Required

"No invitation required"

[Rubato Intro]

Night coming down Forest closing in One narrow road One village within

Lanterns low Roofs leaning tired Smoke without supper Eyes without fire

[Verse 1]

We came upon the village Just before the light was gone Broken fences, muddy pathways Too many stomachs holding on

Coyolings gathered near the houses Packs worn thin from going without Cubs too tired to make a racket Mothers with no milk to give out

Those who still could cross the distance Brought back scraps when instinct came Not enough for every household Not enough to dull the pain

Markets sold what packs required At prices few could ever meet Hunger had become a business

And business had learned how to eat

[Pre-Chorus]

Bella watches every rooftop Tisha takes the village in Fredo holds the reins beside us While the night grows dark and thin

Then an elder steps before me Gray around the ears and eyes

Denta

Firm despite the hunger

Guarding what remains inside

[Chorus]

No invitation required Not tonight Not when hunger’s at the doorway And the cubs have lost the fight

No invitation required Keep your gate and keep your pride If the only rule between us Leaves the starving ones outside

You can tell me turn around You can tell me I don’t belong

But hunger does not care Who entered right or wrong

[Verse 2]

Denta says they need no visitors No one enters after dark No outsiders in the village No exceptions past the mark

Before she reaches the ending I have somewhere else to be

Smoke curls once around my shoulders

Then the road is missing me

I appear beside a young one Small enough to barely stand Bella groans from somewhere distant

I put bread into his hand

He turns it over cautiously Sniffs the crust and looks at me Never seen a thing like this before

Which feels absurd, admittedly

[Pre-Chorus]

One small bite One widened stare Another bite Then crumbs everywhere

The cub looks up And asks for more

And suddenly there are faces At every door

[Chorus]

No invitation required Not tonight Not when someone doesn’t know What breakfast even tastes like

No invitation required Call me rude and call me vain But a boundary built around starvation Is a boundary I’ll profane

They can argue about custom They can whisper that I’m wrong

The hungry do not need permission To survive another dawn

[Bridge]

Tisha

Bring the stores

Everything we packed

Fredo

Set the tables

Nothing travels back

Bread and eggs Pastries too Chicken from the baskets Every bit will do

Tea for elders Warm broth first Something gentle For the worst

Bella keeps one hand ready Still suspicious of the trees

But even she stops arguing When the cubs begin to eat

[Theatrical Lift]

They ask what bread is

Bread

What are pastries?

Pastries

Why would anyone eat eggs?

Because they’re excellent

Where did you find these things?

Home

And why does no one else have them?

That

Is becoming an irritatingly good question

[Final Chorus]

No invitation required Let them eat Let the tables fill with something No one had to hunt or bleed

No invitation required There is room beside the flame No one here should have to suffer Just because the markets name their game

Feed the mothers Feed the young Feed the tired Every one

If tomorrow brings us trouble Then tomorrow can complain

Tonight the village eats

And that is reason enough to stay

[Vamp Outro]

Denta watches from the firelight Still unsure of what she’s seen

A vampire feeding Coyolings

With something soft and clean

A cub holds up the last small crust Like treasure in his hand

I smile

The forest watches too

And somehow

I don’t think it understands
